title: Microsoft 365 Apps admin center: Update Repair in Inventory
summary: Hold: the sources do not establish that Update Repair is included in existing licences or that every supported Inventory administrator can start Repair. The admin-opt-in default also goes beyond the documented requirement to select and confirm each repair; the paths, command and repair prerequisites are supported.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Update Repair is an Inventory capability for identifying Windows devices with outdated Microsoft 365 Apps or update issues and offering remote or manual remediation.
claims.quote: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. ... remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention.

claims.claim: Update Repair uses Inventory data including installed version and build, target version policy and Click-to-Run errors.
claims.quote: Update Repair uses device data reported to Inventory, including the installed Microsoft 365 Apps version and build, the target version policy, and Click-to-Run error information.

claims.claim: The installed version is compared with the latest version available for the configured update channel.
claims.quote: It compares the installed version with the latest version available for the device's configured update channel and assigns a status.

claims.claim: The report shows only devices classified as Needs repair or Needs attention.
claims.quote: The report shows devices in the **Needs repair** and **Needs attention** states. Devices that are **Up to date** or **Outdated** aren't shown because they don't currently require remediation.

claims.claim: Needs repair includes a device at least one version behind with an error that requires no separate remediation.
claims.quote: The device is at least one version behind and has an error that doesn't require separate remediation

claims.claim: Needs repair also includes a device at least three versions behind with no reported error.
claims.quote: or it's at least three versions behind and has no reported error.

claims.claim: Needs attention includes devices with errors requiring separate remediation.
claims.quote: The device has an error that requires separate remediation

claims.claim: Devices that otherwise qualify for repair but run builds earlier than 16.0.20326.20000 are classified as Needs attention.
claims.quote: or it otherwise qualifies for repair but is running a Microsoft 365 Apps build earlier than `16.0.20326.20000`.

claims.claim: No new data collection is described for the report beyond its use of Inventory data.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Any holder of the listed Inventory roles can start Repair, and admin-center role membership is the documented authorization gate for Repair.
claims.quote: Searched: "Update Repair" "Microsoft 365 Apps" "role" and site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/ "Update Repair" "permissions"; opened Inventory and Update Repair. Inventory roles are listed, but Repair authorization is not specified.
claims.fix: Remove 'Any holder can select devices and start a repair' and the assertion that the admin-center role is the only documented Repair authorization gate. Say: 'Inventory lists these access roles; the Update Repair page does not specify which roles can start Repair.' Keep limiting operators as organizational advice, not a documented Repair-specific permission.

claims.claim: A powered-off, signed-out or offline device simply keeps the Repair action pending until it checks in.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/ "Update Repair" "pending" "signed out"; opened Update Repair. It specifies next-check-in delivery and connectivity advice, not pending-action persistence or expiry for unavailable devices.
claims.fix: Replace with: 'Keep devices powered on, signed in and connected so they can receive the action at their next Inventory check-in.' Do not promise that an action remains pending for an unavailable device.
